idioms.raw_block: 54 37 220 َ َ َ َ َ َ َ َ َ 54:37: According to Islahi, the verse is not saying necessarily that the physical eyes of the people in question – the people of Lot – were blotted out: it may signify complete loss of the ability to think and understand – to “see” things as they are. He cites 11:22 as a possible comparison. See also notes to 36:66 and 10:88. 54 38 195 The literal meaning of ح َْ ع/َإنعامَصباحا, َ ص َبis “to attack in the morning”; hence the prayer م َ َ َ “May you be well in the morning”. But then the word came to mean simply “to attack,” ْ regardless of the time of attack. That is why 54:38 contains the word بكر ًَة, indicating that َ ُ the punishment was in fact meted out early in the morning.
